newsitem.title: UK: Cookson sees full yr profits in line.
newsitem.headline: Cookson sees full yr profits in line.

text.p: British electronic and plastic industrial materials company Cookson Group Plc said on Thursday that based on current exchange rates, its profits for the full year would be broadly in line with market expectations.
"We believe that the group has regained momentum following a pause in 1996," group chief executive Richard Oster said in the results statement.

The group reported pre-tax profits before exceptional items of 85.4 million stg in the six months to June -- slightly above most analysts' estimates -- against 85.3 million in same period the year before.

Oster said the rate of improvement seen in the electronics division, especially in the second quarter, "indicates to us that the expected turnaround is now underway and this should lead to further improvement in the second half".

At Cookson Matthey Ceramics (CMC), the group's 50-50 joint venture with Johnson Matthey Plc, profit at the zircon business is expected to stay unchanged, though other activities which make up three-quarters of the unit continue to improve.
The engineered products, advanced refractories and plastics divisions performed well in the first half and enter the second half with sound prospects for further growth, Cookson said.
